Accommodation Tarangire Safari Lodge
Scroll
Accommodation
Our Tents
The quintessential safari tents, with thatched roofs and large, mesh-screened windows, provide the perfect opportunity to connect with the sights and sounds of nature.
Each tent has a comfortable verandah, ideal for bird and game viewing or reading your favorite book after a dusty safari.
With a choice of twin, double or family tents; all are equipped with en-suite bathrooms with 24 hour electricity, solar-heated showers, ample cupboard space for your gear, and a cultural touch of local textiles.
Our Bungalows
The four circular bungalows, built in a similar style to the Maasai boma, offer a more spacious option for family and triple accommodation.
The bungalows are set away from the main lodge, providing privacy, a panoramic view, and all have large en-suite bathrooms with 24 hour electricity, solar-heated showers, and comfortable bedding made from local textiles.
